services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Our 55 foot Patriot offers a hot galley, complete crew, and has a 30 person maximum. The 43 foot Flying Fish offers a hot galley, complete crew and has a 20 person maximum. Patriot Sportfishing Captains make the final call on weather and fishing locations. If it is not safe to go out at all we will work with you to reschedule, otherwise they will fish where the fish have been being caught recently and where they can safely travel to. ALL charters are required to pay a 50% deposit and return the signed Charter Agreement within 14 days of booking. The remaining 50% is due 30 days prior to the trip.. If booking LESS than 30 days prior to date of charter, 100% of the cost is due immediately.
